'''Salaka Kuchimba''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Resistance trooper|soldier]] in the [[Resistance Army|army]] of the [[Resistance]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[First Order]]. He wore a [[Color|green]] [[Clothing|uniform]] jacket and tattered combat [[Hat|cap]] along with a brown [[scarf]], brown pants and brown [[boot]]s. He was equipped with an [[EL-16 blaster rifle]] and had fair skin, green [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salaka Kuchimba was portrayed by [[Griffin Hamill]], son of [[Mark Hamill]], in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
